model.name: R19.25: rb-object-item shows a red child-count badge left of the collapse arrow.
model.description: Every rb-object-item that has children MUST display a badge left of the › expander arrow showing the number of children. The badge is a red circle/oval with the count number inside. Applies globally to rb-object-item everywhere it renders (in-room tree, /trace browser).
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "add left of the collapse arrow a badge with the amount of children — a red circle/var with the number."
